description: Weight per plate divided by theoretical weight per plate.
label: Actual / Theoretical Ratio
name: Batch-custom_actual_to_theoretical_ratio

description: Set by the cutting process on a circular offcut. A round cut has no length and width, so this is the only size it carries.
label: Diameter (mm)
name: Item-custom_diameter_mm

description: Set by the cutting process, not by hand.
label: Is Offcut
name: Item-custom_is_offcut

description: Set by the cutting process on the piece a plate is cut down to. It is not an offcut: the piece stays regular plate stock and its weight is issued against the Project that asked for the cut.
label: Is Remainder
name: Item-custom_is_remainder

description: The Project this Item is made for. A finished good is named from it, as <Project>-00001, and it can only be sold against that Project.
label: Project
name: Item-custom_project

description: The Project this remainder was cut for. Named into the Item so two projects never share a remainder Item.
label: Remainder Project
name: Item-custom_remainder_project

description: Opt in. Only a grade ticked here gets plate weights, Nos enforcement, heat numbers, serial and batch stamping, and a rate per kg. A Formula on its own no longer makes a grade a weighed grade, so an unticked grade is an ordinary group.
label: Is Weighed Grade
name: Item Group-custom_is_weighed_grade

description: Offcuts shorter than this must be booked as scrap. Per grade, because a usable offcut off 2.5 mm plate is not a usable offcut off 25 mm plate. Falls back to Plate Settings when blank.
label: Minimum Offcut Length (mm)
name: Item Group-custom_min_offcut_length_mm

description: Offcuts narrower than this must be booked as scrap. See Minimum Offcut Length. Falls back to Plate Settings when blank.
label: Minimum Offcut Width (mm)
name: Item Group-custom_min_offcut_width_mm

description: Quantity times the theoretical weight per plate.
label: Estimated Weight (Kg)
name: Purchase Order Item-custom_est_weight_kg

description: Entered by the buyer. Nothing overwrites it; an empty line is offered the last rate agreed for this item.
label: Rate per Kg
name: Purchase Order Item-custom_rate_per_kg

description: Net delivered load weight used to allocate weighbridge weight across weighed receipt lines.
label: Truck Net Weight (Kg)
name: Purchase Receipt-custom_truck_net_weight_kg

description: Taken from the Purchase Order line. It is not typed here.
label: Rate per Kg
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_rate_per_kg

description: From the supplier's invoice or challan.
label: Supplier Weight (Kg)
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_supplier_weight_kg

description: Supplier weight against the estimated weight, as a percentage.
label: Variance %
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_variance_pct

description: Only shown when the variance is above tolerance. Permlevel 1, so only the approver role may set it.
label: Weight Decision
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_weight_decision
options:
Accept Supplier Weight
Accept Estimated Weight
Accept Weighbridge Weight

description: Heat number verified during quality inspection.
label: Heat Number
name: Quality Inspection-custom_heat_number

description: Mill test certificate number verified during quality inspection.
label: MTC No
name: Quality Inspection-custom_mtc_no

description: Quantity times the theoretical weight per plate.
label: Estimated Weight (Kg)
name: Supplier Quotation Item-custom_est_weight_kg

description: Enter the supplier's rate per kg. If left blank, it is derived from the quoted rate.
label: Rate per Kg
name: Supplier Quotation Item-custom_rate_per_kg
